name: 晨曦人·男·健壮
src: 主角预设样张（11-10）：人类·晨曦人，男，健壮；战斗装照摧锋
who: A young human man from Gold Kite City, the white-stone capital of the Dawn Empire, about twenty-two, a guild adventurer just starting out: about 200 cm tall and massively muscled, built like a heavyweight wrestler. Short, thick dark-gold hair swept back from the brow, warm amber eyes, a strong, open, good-natured face with straight brows and a small pale scar on the chin. Fair skin. The calm, easy air of a very big man who is careful with his own strength.
build: About 200 cm and massively built, a heavyweight wrestler's frame: enormous rounded shoulders, a broad, thick chest, huge upper arms that fill his sleeves, thick forearms, a thick neck, a broad, solid waist and heavy, powerful legs. Next to an ordinary man he would look a head taller and twice as wide; keep his head in natural proportion.
palette: cream white and dawn gold, warm leather brown, one small crimson accent
casual: His everyday adventurer's kit, in the capital's taste: a cream linen shirt buttoned up to the throat under a high-collared tan leather jerkin with gold-stitched seams, a narrow crimson scarf, two crossed leather straps with small pouches, dark slim trousers tucked into tall brown boots, a short white half-cape hooked on one shoulder, a small bronze guild token hanging from the belt. One hand on the strap across his chest, a friendly, easy expression.
private: Off duty at his lodging: a loose undyed linen shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow and the collar open, braces over it, comfortable brown trousers, soft house shoes. He holds a big mug of tea in one hand. A relaxed, sleepy smile.
battle: A Breaker's starting war gear: a padded cream-and-gold gambeson under a steel breastplate with gold-edged pauldrons, thick leather bracers, a short tabard with the guild token sewn on, armoured boots. In both hands a heavy iron war hammer with a long haft, its square head banded in steel with one faint glowing rune line, held at a slant across the body with its head up. A firm, grounded stance, ready to break a line.
formal: Dawn Empire formal dress for a commoner: a long white tailored coat with a high collar, restrained gold piping and a row of small gold buttons, a narrow gold sash, white gloves, dark trousers and polished boots. Hair combed neatly. Standing very straight and a little stiff, as if he rarely wears this.
art: Seen from slightly below, the war hammer resting on one huge shoulder, his free hand loose at his side, a warm, confident half-smile straight at the viewer; dawn light spilling over his shoulder.

name: 晨曦人·男·中等
src: 主角预设样张（11-10）：人类·晨曦人，男，中等；战斗装照阵剑
who: A young human man from Gold Kite City, the white-stone capital of the Dawn Empire, about twenty-two, a guild adventurer just starting out: about 185 cm with an athletic build. Chestnut-red hair cut medium-short with a side-swept fringe, clear sky-blue eyes, a handsome, earnest face; a small mole under the left eye. Fair skin. An earnest, alert, slightly eager air.
build: About 185 cm, the golden inverted triangle: broad shoulders, a lean narrow waist, long legs, trained and well proportioned.
palette: navy and white, silver, one small sky-blue glow
casual: His everyday adventurer's kit: a fitted navy coat-jacket with a stand collar buttoned to the throat, silver piping and small silver buttons, over a cream shirt; a grey scarf, a narrow belt with a small map case, slim grey trousers tucked into tall black boots, a short navy half-cape lined in white on one shoulder, a small bronze guild token on the belt. Thumb hooked in his belt, an eager half-grin.
private: At his lodging in the evening: a white shirt with the sleeves rolled up, a dark waistcoat left unbuttoned, comfortable trousers, soft shoes. He holds a small open book in one hand, a finger keeping his place. A quiet, absorbed expression.
battle: An Arrayblade's starting gear: a fitted navy-and-white fencing coat with a high collar and silver piping, light steel plates on the chest and the left shoulder, a long fingerless glove on the sword arm, the sleeve carrying a faint chain of glowing blue rune lines, a narrow belt, dark trousers, tall boots. In his right hand a longsword whose fuller is inscribed with a row of runes glowing soft blue, held upright beside him; his left hand traces a small floating blue rune circle near the blade. A tense, ready stance.
formal: Dawn Empire formal dress: a long white tailored coat with a high collar, gold piping and a row of small gold buttons, a narrow gold sash from shoulder to hip, white gloves, dark trousers and polished boots. Hair neatly combed. Upright and composed.
art: A three-quarter view, the rune-lit longsword held up before his face so that its blue glow lights one eye, a determined look past the blade at the viewer.

who: A young human man from Gold Kite City, the white-stone capital of the Dawn Empire, about twenty-two, a guild adventurer just starting out: about 185 cm, tall and lean. Ash-blond hair, a little long, tied low at the nape with a few locks falling over the brow, grey-green eyes behind thin round silver-rimmed glasses, a fine-boned, thoughtful face. Pale skin. A quiet, observant air.
build: About 185 cm, tall and slim: long limbs, shoulders only moderately broad, narrow hips, a lean, wiry frame with little bulk.
palette: charcoal grey and ivory, brass, one small pale-gold glow
casual: His everyday kit: a slim grey-blue coat with a stand collar buttoned to the throat and brass buttons, over an ivory shirt; a leather satchel full of books and rolled papers across the body, a narrow belt, slim trousers, ankle boots, a small bronze guild token on the satchel strap. He holds a pencil and a small notebook. A mild, curious look.
private: Off duty: a soft knitted cream pullover over a shirt collar, loose trousers, felt slippers, glasses pushed up on his head. He holds a cup of coffee and a loose sheet of notes. A tired, contented expression.
battle: A Truth seeker's starting gear: a long fitted charcoal scholar's coat with a high collar, silver piping and many small pockets, a brass-edged leather harness with chalk and small glass vials, fingerless gloves, slim trousers, tall boots. A thick grimoire floats open beside his left hand with pale gold glyphs drifting up off its pages; in his right hand a slim silver wand tipped with a small crystal, pointed down and ready. A tense, analytical look.
formal: Dawn Empire formal dress: a long white tailored coat with a high collar, gold piping and small gold buttons, a narrow gold sash, white gloves, dark trousers, polished shoes. Glasses on, hair tied neatly. Upright, a little awkward.
art: Close on his face behind the round glasses, pale gold glyphs from the floating grimoire drifting across the frame and reflecting in the lenses, a faint, knowing smile.

Long honey-blonde hair worn in a loose side braid over one shoulder, warm hazel-gold eyes, a gentle, kind face with soft cheeks; a small beauty mark at the corner of the mouth. Fair skin. A warm, caring air.
build: About 168 cm, a fuller, voluptuous figure: a very full bust, soft rounded shoulders and arms, a clearly defined waist, wide hips and full thighs, soft but strong. Her clothes stay modest and covering but are fitted at the waist, so that her full figure reads clearly at a glance, clearly fuller than an average woman.
palette: white and warm gold, dusty rose, one small sky-blue accent
casual: Her everyday adventurer's kit: a soft cream blouse with a high collar buttoned to the throat under a fitted brown leather vest, a long dusty-rose travelling skirt with a walking slit over dark leggings, tall brown boots, a small satchel at the hip, a small bronze guild token on a ribbon at her wrist. Both hands holding the satchel strap, a warm, welcoming smile.
private: At home in the evening: a long soft lavender house dress with long sleeves and a modest collar, a knitted cream shawl over her shoulders, hair loose, soft slippers. She holds a small teapot in both hands. A sleepy, contented smile.
battle: A Mercy healer's starting gear: a long white-and-gold healer's coat-dress with a high collar buttoned to the throat over a light chainmail shirt, a gold-edged sky-blue tabard with a small sun badge, a satchel of bandages and glass vials at the hip, white gloves, sturdy boots. In her hand a tall pale-wood staff topped with a small brass lantern holding a warm glowing light, held at a slant with the lantern up. A protective, resolute expression.
formal: Dawn Empire formal dress: a long white gown with a fitted coat bodice, a high collar, gold piping and a row of small gold buttons, a narrow gold sash, white gloves, the braid pinned up neatly. Upright and serene.
art: Holding the glowing lantern staff close, its warm light on her face from below, looking at the viewer with a gentle, reassuring smile, the braid over her shoulder.

art: Drawing the heavy longbow toward the viewer at an angle, one violet-grey eye along the arrow, the fringe lifted by wind, a cool, intent expression.
